turns.text: Hello, come in. How have you been since last time?
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I only checked Oliver's breathing twice last night, that is a big improvement.
How did that feel for you?
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
Take your time.
I am thinking of asking the school to extend my leave until January.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
And how was that for you?
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little.
Tell me more about that.
I am still waiting for the CBT start date, the team said it should arrive soon.
And how was that for you?
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today. That is how it was.
And how was that for you?
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while.
What went through your mind then?
I went to a baby group at the library and spoke to another mum called Sophie.
Take your time.
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television. I think so, yes.
Let us stop here for today.
Thank you, see you next week.
